coordinate_system: Transparent orthographic renders mapped to VP SVG user units

track_module.use: Repeating static ballast, sleepers and metal rails beneath main-line and diagonal ATS SVG routes

platform_module.use: Raised platform deck with modular panels, canopies and benches

station_sign.use: Blank cyan-metal station sign backing; dynamic station names remain SVG text

pv_header.use: Static industrial PV housing; PV identifier remains SVG text

pv_rotor.animation: A Blender-keyframed five-blade rotor rendered as a 2D sprite and rotated smoothly by CSS; stopped by prefers-reduced-motion

safety.interactive_topology: SVG remains authoritative for track, crossings, work spans, signals and 1500V/0V status
safety.sprites: Decorative and pointer-events-none; no operational state is encoded in the Blender renders
